searchText: Is there some status update on history expiry for testnets? I'm aware of besu and geth having done testing on releases. Can we get an update from the other EL clients? So history will be dropped on Sepolia on May 1st? Is there some docs or announcement on how people can try this out after the date? Or is it just resync post this date and the node won't have history? And where can we point them to era files/approaches to re-import history if they need it? (geth's latest release has no mention of history expiry btw) Each client has agency to execute this differently. Client teams will need to make their own announcements about any changes to client behavior. There's no unified announcement that can be made because this change doesn't impose any requirements on external facing client APIs, only on the DevP2P layer. Fair enough, but it is ~1 week before the date and we have seen no announcements about it yet? Maybe a compilation page, similar to das.wtf could be a place to point people to if they're interested? https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-7927 ? Okay, so EIP + client docs is the canonical approach Is anyone hosting the era files for sepolia already? That's the agreed upon fallback mechanism right? Or what is the recovery mode if every node on the network drops history? https://eth-clients.github.io/history-endpoints/#sepolia Thank you! 😄 With May 1st coming up quickly, I'd like to aggregate information from each client about how client behavior will change. Can I get either a response posted here (https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/history-expiry-meta-eip/23359) or a link to your client documentation on this? Sepolia drop is May 1st and then Pectra not long after.
